title: Exciting Visit of Mysterious Seville
text: My family and I greatly enjoyed this interesting Route, thanks to the excellent tour guide JOSE MANUEL GARCIA BAUTISTA. In addition to demonstrating his extensive experience and knowledge on the subject of the mysterious and the paranormal, José Manuel has the gift of making your visit very enjoyable. It’s got us involved throughout the tour and it gets you into every story. Highly recommended. Without a doubt, we will repeat with José Manuel García Bautista. We encourage everyone to get to know this mysterious part of the History of Seville! Congratulations to the formidable guide.
author: 903v_ctort

title: The best paranormal route with the best guide: José Manuel García Bautista.
text: Spectacular guide, José Manuel García Bautista, very good at everything he had, with a lot of documentation, as well as a researcher, getting you into the story and making you live the experience. We found his way of explaining and making us live everything beastly. Very good, very very good. Recommended.
